text:
omar: Heads-up  stayed at a boutique hotel in Lisbon for 2 nights. Hotel only gave a pro-forma (no VAT breakdown) and says they can9t reissue an itemized invoice until next week. Total was 214.60 EUR. I need to submit for reimbursement today. What should I upload? cc @finance-team
nina: We can accept a pro-forma temporarily but need manager approval + evidence of payment. Please upload: (1) your card/bank screenshot showing the charge, (2) the pro-forma PDF, and (3) a short note "awaiting itemized VAT invoice from hotel (expected DATE)". Tag with HOTEL-WAIT-VAT.
omar: uploaded bank-screenshot.png and proforma.pdf. Note added: "hotel to provide itemized invoice by 2025-05-10."
expense-bot: New expense submitted by omar  amount: 214.60 EUR, tags: HOTEL-WAIT-VAT, status: awaiting manager approval. Expense ID: EXP-2025-0034.
kelly: manager approval granted on condition that you follow up and attach the itemized invoice when received. Also, if no VAT reclaim is possible we may treat it as non-reclaimable. Approved for reimbursement to avoid payroll delay. :white_check_mark:
nina: Thanks, kelly. Processing reimbursement for Omar. Finance note: "pending VAT invoice; flagged for VAT audit when provided."
omar: thanks all 60a I9ll chase the hotel for itemized invoice and upload when I get it.
